text: Your next phone could cost you more, and you're already paying for it.
Its memory chip costs about three times January's price.
The chip is RAM. Your device is short-term memory.
Trendforce says contract prices jumped 80% in spring, 40% in summer, and another 20% is coming.
So who's buying up all the memory?
Data centers running chatbots need mountains of memory and they pay more
than phone makers. So chip makers shift their factories to AI memory and less is
left for your laptop. And that's not even the weirdest part. In a way the free
chatbot on your phone is helping push up the price of your phone. AI felt free.
